content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Event Keywords ## slug: event-keywords ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Use specific keywords or phrases to help improve the searchability of your {{variable.Object_Event}}! ## Use Case If you are hosting an outdoor cooking event, your keywords might include: BBQ, barbeque, outdoor event, grilling, cookout, etc. Adding these as keywords will increase searchability for people looking to attend your event! ![Blackthorn Events - Keywords Feature](https://youtu.be/qBLuDYukBEs){height="480" width="640"} ## Instructions Follow along to set up your keywords! 1. Navigate to an {{variable.Object_Event}} record. 2. Click **Manage Keywords**. ![Instructions 1\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Instructions%201%281%29.png){height="" width=""} 3. Type in a keyword, and click {{variable.Button_CreateNewKeyword}}. ![Instructions 2\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Instructions%202%281%29.png){height="" width=""} 4. Create as many {{variable.Object_Keyword}}s as you'd like for an {{variable.Object_Event}}. When you are done, click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 5. Once you have several {{variable.Object_Event}}s with {{variable.Object_Keyword}}s, navigate to the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} that your {{variable.Object_Event}}s are a part of. 6. Change the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_UIExperience}} value to {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_UI_Aspen}}, {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_UI_Maple}}, or {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_UI_List}}. ![Instructions 3\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Instructions%203%281%29.png){height="" width=""} 7. Click on the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} to load the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} webpage. 8. Check it out and play around! ## Examples The left hand column is an example of all {{variable.Object_Keyword}}s associated with the {{variable.Object_Event}}s in the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}}. In this example, "Interest," "Type," and "Location" are all Categories. * Maple UI: Everything under the dotted line is a {{variable.Object_Keyword}} without the {{variable.Object_Keyword}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Category}} field defined. * Aspen and List UI: {{variable.Object_Keyword}}s without a defined {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Category}} will appear in the Undefined section. ### Aspen UI ![Keywords_EventGroup_AspenUI](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Keywords_EventGroup_AspenUI.png){height="" width=""} ### Maple UI ![Keywords_EventGroup_MapleUI](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Keywords_EventGroup_MapleUI.png){height="" width=""} ### List UI ![Keywords_EventGroup_ListUI](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Keywords_EventGroup_ListUI.png){height="" width=""}
